Progression / References

Military Tier sources and version notes

Where the progression advice comes from, which claims need version checks, and how to distinguish requirements from strategy.

This series adapts the two supplied documents, The Perfect Tower II — Complete Military Tier Progression Guide and Cited Research and Source Library. The guides were organized and expanded on October 30, 2026. Live web revalidation was unavailable during publication; these links preserve the cited basis of that research.

Read each kind of evidence differently

  • Developer changelog: use it for changes between releases.
  • Community mechanics: useful explanations, but check old tables against the current game.
  • Community strategy: a suggested way to progress, not a mandatory objective or guaranteed optimal build.
  • Editorial guidance: the step order and troubleshooting explanations connect the supplied mechanics into an approachable route.

Corrections retained from the supplied research

  • The v1.0.1 changelog is cited for the MT5 change from 100 to 80 maximized modules. [S01]
  • Historical total-module-tier targets from MT6 onward are not reliable current thresholds. The old MT6 boss requirement is also flagged as removed. [S01] [S02]
  • Old Era minimum-hit-damage advice, divisor costs and Era Tunneling behavior need version checks. [S01] [S08]
  • Stone requirements differ across older guides. Read the current Infinity Board before spending toward a numerical target. [S09] [S12]

Copyable source library

  1. S01 — Official developer changelogDeveloper changes

    The supplied research identifies v1.0 changes and the v1.0.1 reduction of the MT5 objective to 80 maximized modules. Live page revalidation was unavailable for this publication.

  2. S02 — Military Tier requirements and rewardsCommunity mechanics

    The supplied research flags this table as outdated after v1.0, particularly total-module-tier requirements. Use the current Headquarters display for exact promotion requirements.

  3. S03 — Military Tier 0–1 beginner walkthroughCommunity walkthrough

    Opening combat, Workshop progression, regions and the first promotion.

  4. S04 — Progression guide indexCommunity walkthroughs

    Early economy, workers and specialization guidance. Some linked tier pages are unfinished.

  5. S05 — Military perksCommunity mechanics

    Backups, Duplicates, specializations and later perk effects. A suggested perk order is a strategy, not a required route.

  6. S06 — Modules and unlock locationsCommunity reference

    Module effects, region drops, Laboratory rewards and other unlock routes.

  7. S07 — Headquarters, software and Facility AICommunity mechanics

    Research servers, software unlocks, wave acceleration and scripting. Read individual software tooltips in your installed version.

  8. S08 — Era mechanicsCommunity mechanics

    Analysis, research, experiments, elemental powers and divisors. Older hit-damage rules and numerical costs were changed in v1.0.

  9. S09 — Infinity mechanics and stonesCommunity mechanics

    Infinity combat, the Grid, Anvil, stones and charging. Stone requirements in older community guides disagree; the Infinity Board is authoritative.

  10. S10 — Military Tier 11–13 community walkthroughOlder community strategy

    Late Era and early Infinity advice. The supplied research dates this incomplete guide to 2023; imported builds and timings are not verified for the current release.

  11. S11 — Military Tier 14–15 community walkthroughOlder community strategy

    Regional Infinity farming and late progression. Its MT15 section is unfinished and its blueprints predate later changes.

  12. S12 — ExpertLove’s full-game guideCommunity strategy collection

    Practical wave, Era, Infinity, blueprint and automation advice. Version-dependent recommendations are not current requirements.

  13. S13 — Steam Modules GuideOlder community strategy

    Short-run module farming. The supplied research describes this 2024 guide as marked removed/incompatible by Steam; prefer the module reference for unlock facts.

Sources not promoted into direct references

The supplied appendix mentions three Steam discussions about MT9→10, wave acceleration and Era XP, but does not supply their exact discussion URLs. They are not linked as verified references here, and their numerical timing or cost claims are not used as current requirements. General explanations instead point to the identified Era and Headquarters references.

These walkthroughs were not independently play-tested across every tier. If your screen disagrees with a guide, use the in-game requirement and consult the developer changelog.
